notes.title: Kinder Finders Summer Days is Here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467073/00989208b75b53f4273a2eaddbd95003e70b5a06.png[/img]

It's time for Summer and the Kinder Finders are on vacation at the Blue Seahorse Hotel. 

Come enjoy the beach, a brand new level, and some cozy finding.

This free update includes:

- A Brand New Level
- 7 New Quests (with plenty of items to find and badges to earn)
- 2 Characters and a bunch of summer designs for classic characters
- 2 new music tracks from Dj Kenneth A (a summer vibes remake of the main theme and one for the new level)

And all the charm you'd expect from Kinder Finders.

It's all free and ready for you to enjoy.

notes.title: The Golden Chase Update
notes.notes:
Not a lot in this update except the addition of separate buttons to start a new game fresh or start a new game at the Golden Chase (the final quest that unlocks when you earn every badge in the game). 

It should be fun for folks looking to enjoy the challenge of the Golden Chase again and maybe we can have some fun with speed running it. 

Further this update lays out the space in which future content can be listed in the game. Allowing you to play the upcoming free content updates at your leisure.

notes.title: Kinder Finders: Summer Days Coming June 2nd
notes.notes:
[h1]Free Content Update is Coming June 2nd[/h1]

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/620ec5e8737fb26f9772ec13/38a11a01-1d04-4aab-9364-1ee8fc949252/Summer+Days.png?format=1000w[img]https://drive.google.com/file/d/1tJKvT5zXVDyuwZuKWkLRmTLnGEiAk10-/view?usp=drive_link[/img][/img]

[h2]Summer is Coming to Kinder Finders[/h2]

Get your sunglasses, put on the sunscreen, and get ready for a brand new level in Kinder Finders. Come join some of your old friends and some new ones on the lovely beaches at The Blue Seahorse Hotel. 

Featuring summer themed redesigns of Kinder Finder characters, a brand new level with quests and objects to find, a new soundtrack theme, and a remix of the original Kinder Finders track with a summer vibe. There are new characters to meet and plenty of things to find. 

[h2]And Its All Free![/h2]

Kinder Finders: Summer Days Free Content Update releasing June 2nd. 

[h2]The Golden Chase Update[/h2]

I'll be pushing a new update today with some minor improvements including the ability to start the game at the golden chase rather than having to restart the whole game to that extra hard challenge. 

I'm going to be posting some fun speed runs of my attempts to do the golden chase. Feel free to share yours. 

This update will lay the ground work for the summer update and more updates to come.

[h2]A Big Thanks[/h2]

This content update and the summer update are my way of saying thank you for supporting the game. I have had so much more encouragement and enthusiasm than I could have imagined. Kinder Finders will see a roll out of fresh content (all free) over the next year. These will be in celebration of the game and what I love about it and more so a gift to anyone who chose to play my little hidden object game. 

So thank you.

Kindly and Findly yours,
Patrick
Games by Sutherland

notes.title: One More Patch Before the Weekend - Quality of Life
notes.notes:
I want to take a moment to thank everyone who has been playing Kinder Finders. Those who have streamed or made videos I've been making an effort to watch and reflect on your experience.

My goal is to improve on the game as much as I can (within limits). And one such oversight was my end game. The golden chase had no fanfare. I guess it was something I had planned but had failed to properly execute on (It might have been something that was beyond me at the time). So I went in today and added that properly. 

The game should be back to its stable self. And once again I apologies to anyone who lost a save file or had trouble in the last 24 hours. 

Many thanks.
Kindly and Findly,
Patrick

notes.title: Save Games Should No Longer Reset - The Apologies of a new dev on a solo team
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Rough 20 hours or so for Kinder Finders. I did some bug fixes that broke the game. Apologies for anyone trying to play in the last 24 hours. Please reach out to me if that was your experience. 

I should have fixed the error now.

I also learned that my fixes forced a rewrite on save files if you ran the game. It was an oversight on my part but I should have also fixed that. If you are running into errors with that let me know.

Like my last post, I can manufacture a save file for you relative to your lost save file. Just reach out and we will get that to you when we can. 

thanks for your patience.

notes.title: Quick Patch - Oops I broke it
notes.notes:
Apologies to everyone I broke the game with my last update. And I seemed to have created a save destruction too. 

This patch fixes the break and I'll be fixing the save game problem shortly. If you have lost your saved game I can try to replicate for you the file. Please comment and let me know and I'll get you a new save file that matches your previous save.

notes.title: Update - Release Version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Quality of Life:

I'm working on making the menus a bit more informative and clear. Including adding a close button for mouse users. 
Each one of these updates adds just a little more polish to the game.

Bugs:

There was a looming bug where once a quest was started the items suddenly became unclickable. This should have been resolved in this patch. I was able to replicate the problem and find it's source. 

Should it persist let me know.

Edits:
Fixed the Conductor's dialogue to make sense.

notes.title: Kinder Finders Release Patch - 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hey Friends,

I just wanted to reach out and express my thanks for all of the people who have chosen to support the release of Kinder Finders. When I started making this game it was a pipe dream and here on the other side of last Thursday's release it is very real. And that is because of [b]YOU[/b].

I appreciate all the feedback and reviews. You are all very kind. And I have been taking bug reports and making changes as necessary (not as many bugs as I worried about but still just a few stragglers).

This update is about one of those bugs. I won't get into detail but essentially if you were so excited to play the game that you finished it and wanted to immediately restart (without closing the game) you would find some data lingered from your previous save. Mainly in the map menu. And this was unhelpful.

It should now be fixed. And I'm gearing up to fix any other issues we may find. 

Equally, watch this space. I have some official unannounced plans for free content updates coming down the pipeline (hoping to land in June). 

I'm excited to continue to update the game and release more content for players especially those who have already bought the game. 

Kindly and Findly,
Patrick
Games By Sutherland
